name: lean-ecommerce-engine
description: File-based e-commerce backend. D1 for stock/orders. Cloudflare Workers for API.

scripts.predeploy:api: node -e "const t=require('fs').readFileSync('wrangler.toml','utf8'); if(t.includes('your-d1-database-id')||t.includes('your-store.pages.dev')||t.includes('your-store-assets')) { console.error('\x1b[31m✗ wrangler.toml still has placeholder values — run bash setup.sh first\x1b[0m'); process.exit(1); }"
